mapper.sql: id, project_id, task_no, task_name, task_type, task_status, task_description, task_objectives, deliverables, quality_requirements, time_requirements, resource_requirements, technical_requirements, safety_requirements, environmental_requirements, assigned_person_id, assigned_team_members, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, planned_workload, actual_workload, budget_amount, actual_cost, progress_percentage, issuer_id, issue_date, reviewer_id, review_date, review_comments, completion_report, acceptance_person_id, acceptance_date, acceptance_result, acceptance_comments, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_assignment ( project_id, task_no, task_name, task_type, task_status, task_description, task_objectives, deliverables, quality_requirements, time_requirements, resource_requirements, technical_requirements, safety_requirements, environmental_requirements, assigned_person_id, assigned_team_members, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, planned_workload, budget_amount, issuer_id, issue_date, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{taskNo}, #{taskName}, #{taskType}, #{taskStatus}, #{taskDescription}, #{taskObjectives}, #{deliverables}, #{qualityRequirements}, #{timeRequirements}, #{resourceRequirements}, #{technicalRequirements}, #{safetyRequirements}, #{environmentalRequirements}, #{assignedPersonId}, #{assignedTeamMembers}, #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedEndDate}, #{plannedWorkload}, #{budgetAmount}, #{issuerId}, #{issueDate}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{createBy}, #{updateBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX( CASE WHEN task_no LIKE 'TASK' || #{dateStr} || '%' THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(task_no, 13, 4)) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS max_seq FROM task_assignment WHERE task_no LIKE 'TASK' || #{dateStr} || '%'
